bgm.name: FRLG City - Sevii 3 - Six and Seven Island (Sevii Islands - Six and Seven Island)

parameters: \bIf I train here, I'm convinced that I'll get stronger and stronger.
\bHow would you like to learn a move like that? It's Swords Dance.
\bIf only we could keep getting stronger and stronger, eh?
\bThis island has been left virtually untouched in its natural state.
\bIt could be a little difficult to hike around because of that.
\rThese islands are called the Sevii Islands because there are seven.
\r…Or at least, that's what the young people believe.
\rThe truth is, these islands are so named because they are said to have been made in seven days.
